Tuesday, December 13, 2016

FOR THE RECORD

Man arrested in Arizona for armed jewelry store robbery

By SUZANNE CARLSON Daily News Staff

Police have extradited a man from Arizona and charged him in connec-tion with the 2013 armed robbery of Gems and Gold Corner, according to VL. Police spokeswoman Sakeeda Freeman.

Ron Kuntz, 42, was arrested at 11:55 p.m. Saturday and charged with first-degree robbery, second-de-gree robbery, grand larceny, first-de- gree assault, third-degree assault, de-struction of property, and aiding and abetting. Bail was set at $150,000.

The robbery occurred just before 10 a.m. when a man entered the store and pulled a handgun from his waist, police said at the time. The robber told the owner, who was the only person in the store at the time, to get down and then broke out some of the glass cases in the store.

Police did not say what the value of the goods taken was.

Kuntz was apprehended and de-tained in Tempe, Ariz., after a rou- tine traffic stop, and Arizona police discovered there was an outstanding warrant for Kuntz from the U.S. Vir-gin Islands, Freeman said.
